user.title: Configure Milesight Gateway
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Milesight gateway.

data_description.gateway_url: The URL of your Milesight gateway with http:// or https:// but without the port, for example `https://192.0.2.10`.
data_description.port: The port of the gateway API.
data_description.username: The username to log in to the Milesight gateway.
data_description.password: The password to log in to the Milesight gateway.
data_description.secret_key: The 16-character AES encryption key for the gateway password.
data_description.iv: The 16-character AES initialization vector for the gateway password.
data_description.gateway_mqtt_base_topic: The MQTT topic prefix for sensor uplink messages, for example `sensors/lora/uplink`.

devices.title: Choose devices
devices.description: The gateway lists {count} devices with a known model. Pick the ones that should get entities in Home Assistant, or leave the list empty for all of them.

data_description.data_source: Where sensor values come from. LoRaWAN reads the gateway's packet log and decodes with Milesight's own codecs; no MQTT broker needed. MQTT takes what the gateway publishes, decoded by the codecs set up on the gateway.
data_description.devices: Searchable by name, model and devEUI. You can change the choice later in the options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with your Milesight gateway
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current ones.

data_description.username: The username to log in to the Milesight gateway.
data_description.password: The current password to log in to the Milesight gateway.
data_description.secret_key: The 16-character AES encryption key for the gateway password.
data_description.iv: The 16-character AES initialization vector for the gateway password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Milesight Gateway
reconfigure.description: Update the address and credentials for your Milesight gateway. Leave the password empty to keep the stored one.

data_description.gateway_url: The URL of your Milesight gateway with http:// or https:// but without the port, for example `https://192.0.2.10`. Change this if the gateway moved to a different address.
data_description.port: The port of the gateway API.
data_description.username: The username to log in to the Milesight gateway.
data_description.password: The new password to log in to the Milesight gateway.
data_description.secret_key: The 16-character AES encryption key for the gateway password.
data_description.iv: The 16-character AES initialization vector for the gateway password.
data_description.gateway_mqtt_base_topic: The MQTT topic prefix for sensor uplink messages, for example `sensors/lora/uplink`.

error.missing_scheme: Start the URL with http:// or https://, for example https://192.0.2.10.
error.url_with_port: Leave the port out of the URL and enter it in the Port field.
error.invalid_url: Enter only the gateway's address, for example https://192.0.2.10, without a path or user name.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the device list from the gateway. Sensor values arrive by MQTT as soon as they are sent.
data_description.status_interval: How often to read the gateway's status: links, packets, CPU and memory.
data_description.web_data: Log in to the gateway's web interface for its serial number, CPU load, memory, storage and uptime. Uses the same account.
data_description.firmware_check: Look up the newest gateway firmware on milesight.com twice a day.
data_description.devices: Only these devices get entities. Leave empty for all devices. Devices you remove from the list are removed from Home Assistant with their entities.
data_description.data_source: Where sensor values come from. LoRaWAN reads the gateway's packet log and decodes with Milesight's own codecs; no MQTT broker needed. MQTT takes what the gateway publishes, decoded by the codecs set up on the gateway.
data_description.all_settings: LoRaWAN source only. Off: report interval, target temperature, reboot and status report. On: about 25 more per device, disabled until you enable them.

downlink_failed.message: The gateway did not accept the command for the device: {error}
